$description: Pre-built FeatureMockup overlay configs for common product features. Reference any preset by name from a project's timeline.json by using the `feature_mockup` lane (planned) or by copy-pasting the props block into an overlay entry. Each preset includes: label, iconPath (24x24 viewBox SVG path), iconPath2 (optional second stroke), default details bullets. Override any field per-use.

sandboxing.label: Sandboxing
sandboxing.description: Shield icon. Use for: secure execution, isolated environments, per-agent sandboxing.

credentials.label: Credentials
credentials.description: Key icon. Use for: credential vaults, secret management, OAuth tokens, API keys.

checkpointing.label: Checkpointing
checkpointing.description: Save/disk icon. Use for: persistent state, autosave, resumable execution.

tracing.label: Tracing
tracing.description: Line chart icon. Use for: execution traces, observability, audit logs.

monitoring.label: Monitoring
monitoring.description: Crosshair icon. Use for: monitoring, alerting, metrics dashboards.

scaling.label: Auto-scaling
scaling.description: Globe icon. Use for: scaling, distribution, multi-region.

integration.label: Integration
integration.description: Connection arrows icon. Use for: integration, plug-and-play, API surfaces.

performance.label: Performance
performance.description: Lightning bolt icon. Use for: speed, latency, performance wins.

automation.description: Clock icon. Use for: scheduled jobs, automation, cron-style tasks.

permissions.label: Permissions
